deadline.intake: Winter semester 15 July; summer semester 15 January (years not stated)

tuition.note: LMU fees page states no tuition since WS 2013/14 but is undated for 2025+; not confirmed for non-EU

requirement.text: Non-EU certificates need an official equivalence check (ANABIN/DAAD), otherwise a Studienkolleg year; bachelor applicants need a uni-assist VPD, recognized German proof and apply via the International Office.
